title: fix(spec)!: a dataset or measure filter with a list inside a nested relation is refused on save (#20080)
body:
Fixes #20080
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

A dataset `filter` and a measure `filter` now refuse, when the dataset is saved, a list in the equality slot of a field inside a nested-relation condition: `{ account: { region: ['a'] } }` and `{ account: { region: { $eq: ['a'] } } }`, the empty list included, at any relation depth and under `$and` / `$or` / `$not`.

Before, at `origin/main` `9e7824a445`, `DatasetSchema.safeParse` answered `success: true` for both shapes. The analytics `where` door charts both carriers on every path (the native-SQL and ObjectQL strategies and the draft preview). It flattens the relation to the dotted member `account.region` and hands the list to the shared comparand-shape face, which refuses it with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400. So the dataset saved clean and every chart on it failed.

This is remedy A as triage routed it (record 5825670610). The shared `FilterConditionSchema` is not touched: ruling A (record 5805248669) keeps its reach at the face's, because the engine reads a no-`$` field spec as a deep-equality comparand. Remedy B (the analytics door stops descending) is not taken.

## How

- `packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts`: `refuseNestedRelationEqualityLists` walks a filter the way the analytics door's `mapWhereFieldEntries` does. It descends `$and` / `$or` arrays and `$not`, skips every other `$` key, and descends a plain object with no `$` key as a nested relation, at any depth. The nested-relation test is the door's own `isNestedRelationSpec`: prototype `Object.prototype` or `null`, no `$` key. Inside a nested relation it refuses exactly what `assertNoListInEqualitySlot` refuses there: an array spec (implicit form), or an object spec whose `$eq` is an array. It reports ONLY inside a nested relation. Everything outside one is `FilterConditionSchema`'s own refusal, so nothing is reported twice.
- The words come from `arrayEqualityComparandMessage`, the one builder the face and the schema door both print from. The analytics door appends ` at where.account.region`. The carrier leaves that out, as the schema door does, and the issue `path` carries it instead (`filter.account.region`, `measures.0.filter.account.region.$eq`).
- The check sits on each carrier's `.optional()` wrapper, not on `FilterConditionSchema` itself. A first cut refined the recursive schema directly. That clones it, and the published `ui/Dataset.json` then inlined a second copy of the condition beside its `$ref`. On the wrapper, the published bodies of `ui/Dataset` and `ui/DatasetMeasure` are byte-identical to base, apart from `x-dropped-refinements`. That was measured by generating both trees and comparing the JSON with that key removed.
- `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`: the new rule is declared where `z.toJSONSchema()` drops it. That is 11 new sites across 6 existing entries (`filter` on both carriers, `measures.element.filter`, and the four manifest embeddings), exactly as `build-schemas.ts` printed them. The header total moves 574 to 585.

## ADR-0087 registration

A new semantic entry, `dataset-filter-nested-relation-equality-array-refused-at-save` (protocol major 18), plus its regenerated `registry.ts` region. The projections (`spec-changes.json`, `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md`) cover up to the current protocol major 17, so they do not move. `check:spec-changes` and `check:upgrade-guide` are green.

Two unreleased major-18 sibling entries each had one sentence this change makes false, so each gets a minimal correction:
- `filter-equality-array-comparand-refused-at-save`: its position (1) said the nested-relation list is refused only when charted. It now also names the carriers' refusal on save. Its acceptance criteria get the matching exception.
- `filter-equality-array-comparand-refused`: "that door alone also refuses a list inside a nested-relation condition" now reads "among the runtime doors", and the save-side list names the two carriers.

## Deliberate correction of two pending changesets

`Check Changeset` (`check-empty-changeset`) is red on purpose. It is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class that gate's own text names, ⛔ not a collision, and no `skip-changeset` label is applied. Both pending notes described an exception this PR removes. Triage item 2 (record 5825670610) requires the correction to land in the same PR if this card lands before the next `changeset version`.

- `.changeset/19889-filter-schema-door-array-equality.md`: the "reach is the face's" bullet said the nested-relation list "is not judged" and is refused when a dataset or measure filter is charted. It now says `FilterConditionSchema` does not judge it, and that the two carriers the analytics door charts refuse it on save.
- `.changeset/19888-analytics-implicit-array.md`: "A document carrying that still publishes, and it is refused when it is charted" now says a dataset or measure filter is refused on save, and that any other `where` reaching the door, such as a caller `where` or a dataset selection `runtimeFilter`, is still refused only when charted.

Please confirm both corrections. Restoring either note from base would republish a false sentence.

This PR's own changeset is `.changeset/20080-dataset-filter-nested-relation-list.md` (`@objectstack/spec`: `minor`, BREAKING narrowing, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, ADR-0087 `registered`). `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-changeset-no-major` are green.

## Evidence

All runs below are at head `3ed391abf9` unless another sha is named. They went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, and each exit code was captured before any pipe.

- **New pins**, `packages/spec/src/ui/dataset-filter-nested-relation-list.test.ts`: 68 passed.
  - §1: 12 nested shapes are refused at the list's own path on `DatasetSchema.filter`, on a measure filter through `DatasetSchema`, and on `DatasetMeasureSchema` alone. One more case checks that a single document reports every such list.
  - §2: the carrier's message EQUALS the analytics door's refusal with the location clause removed. The door's refusal is rebuilt from the one-entry node it hands the face, carries envelope `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, and the clause is proven present exactly once.
  - §3: a list outside a nested relation is reported exactly ONCE.
  - §4: 13 controls are accepted and kept on both carriers. The shared `FilterConditionSchema` still accepts both nested shapes, so ruling A is untouched.
- **Ablation 1** (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 to 0, restore proven): with the refinement removed, 50 failed and 18 passed. §1 and §2 went red; the §3 and §4 controls stayed green. Restore check: blob == HEAD `781a5b6df01f`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Ablation 2**: with the outside-a-relation guard removed, exactly the 4 §3 rows went red (4 failed, 64 passed). Restore proven the same way.
- **Cross-door conformance** (one-off, not committed): 3000 seeded random filters went through the REAL analytics door (`normalizeAnalyticsFilterTree`, service-analytics source) and the rebuilt `DatasetSchema`. The door refused 2240 with the equality-slot sentence, and 1304 of those sit where the shared schema alone would miss them. The carrier agreed on all 3000, with 0 mismatches: the same sentence whenever the door refused, and no equality issue whenever it accepted.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` at `43df1403dd`: 15902 passed, 1 failed, 2 todo. The failure was the ledger header total, fixed in `3ed391abf9`. That file (`scripts/dropped-refinements.test.ts`) plus the new pins, rerun at `3ed391abf9`: 95 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck` reports OK (53 files / 255 errors held in the ledger). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test file once, and 0 of the 255 errors sit in any touched file.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && check:generated` at `43df1403dd`: all 15 generated artifacts up to date. `gen:schema` was rerun at `3ed391abf9` for the ledger: exit 0, 585 refinement sites across 207 published schemas, all declared in the ledger, 1549 schemas generated, and the tree left clean.
- **Published JSON Schema**: base and head `ui/Dataset.json` / `ui/DatasetMeasure.json` were generated side by side (a compare worktree at `9e7824a445`). The bodies are byte-identical with `x-dropped-refinements` removed.
- **Consumers.** Test-filter direction is the upstream prefix form, `--filter '@objectstack/service-analytics^...'`, which built its 14-package closure.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics test`: 128 files and 3017 tests passed, all 128 tracked test files. That includes the read-only control `where-equality-slot-list-refusal.test.ts`, so the analytics door's refusal is unchanged.
  - `packages/metadata` `typescript-serializer-annotation.test.ts`: 7 passed.
  - `packages/platform-objects` `report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts`: 35 passed.
  - `packages/rest` (3 files) and `packages/cli` (1 file) are declared to CI; their closures are 25 and 57 packages. Static sweep: none of the 80 consumer test files that reference `DatasetSchema` passes a list under a nested relation through it. The only such literals go straight to the analytics door or to read-scope compilers.
- **Gates.** Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at `3ed391abf9` (identical to the derivation at `43df1403dd`). Reconciled with `--ran`: 87 derived, 85 run, 2 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.
  - 84 exit 0.
  - `check-empty-changeset` exits 1 BY DESIGN (see the deliberate-correction section).
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:type-check-debt` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, both exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they need the whole-repo build, which CI does).
- **Lint**, a declared narrowing: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 6 touched TS files reported 6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, none ignored. The repo's one `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (its own note, about line 326), and no touched module's exports changed, so no untouched file's verdict can move. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Census

In-repo, at `9e7824a445`: 0 dataset or measure filters carry a list under a nested relation. The scan covered the dataset definitions of `examples/app-crm`, `examples/app-showcase` and `examples/app-todo`, the platform objects' `system.datasets.ts`, the dataset examples in `content/docs` and `skills`, and a repo-wide literal scan of non-test `filter` / `where` carriers. Deployed datasets: NOT MEASURED.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same family, measured, not fixed here.** The shared face's OTHER arms are accepted by `DatasetSchema.filter` at the top level AND inside a nested relation: a `null` ordering comparand (`$gt: null`), a non-list `$in`, a `null` member of `$in`, and a `null` `$between` endpoint. The shared face refuses each with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, and so does the analytics door when it charts the filter. Probe at `3ed391abf9`, with a control dataset that parses: `{ amount: { $gt: null } }`, `{ stage: { $in: 'won' } }`, `{ amount: { $between: [null, 5] } }` and their `{ acct: … }` nested forms all answer `success: true`. This is the #19889 / #20116 save-door family, and it is reported for the PM to fold into that family rather than filed singly. Dedupe words: `dataset filter $gt null accepted at save` · `FilterConditionSchema other comparand arms not judged at save` · `$in non-list dataset filter saves clean`.
- **Other routes to the analytics door.** A caller `where` and a dataset selection `runtimeFilter` still reach the door with a nested list and are refused when charted. Both are requests, so the refusal is loud to the caller. Whether a stored dashboard widget `filter` or report `runtimeFilter` reaches the door that way is decided on the objectui side and was NOT MEASURED here.
- **Stale header number, noted and not filed.** `dropped-refinements.baseline.json`'s `measured.refinementSitesThatDidProject` reads 369, while `build-schemas.ts` prints 409 at base `9e7824a445` and at head. No test reads that field. Nobody is carrying it.
- The claim's `Clause-②: no` is copied above verbatim. This PR's changeset carries `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, the spelling the ADR-0087 gate reads.
